reasons.newer_than_running: newer than the running {version} (an update may be installing it)
reasons.newer_than_kept: built after the version this install uses (an update, or another install on this engine)
reasons.unclaimed: not configured and not in use
reasons.nothing_to_compare: nothing configured to compare it with
reasons.stale_base: older than the FROM the Dockerfiles pin
reasons.kind_node: kind node image, no kind cluster running
reasons.engine_cache: engines installed on first use, for {scope}
